verdict.rationale: Braintrust's Go SDK documents that its tracing is built on OpenTelemetry, so developers instrument their own code with the standard OpenTelemetry API instead of a proprietary one. However, the pack never documents an OTLP ingestion endpoint, OTLP export of traces out of Braintrust, or OTel support outside the Go SDK. Missing for 10: documented OTLP endpoint for receiving traces, OTLP export or forwarding of traces, OTel support across the other SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Java), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) instead of a proprietary format

citations.quote: Tracing is built on OpenTelemetry, so you trace your own code with the standard OpenTelemetry API.
Tracing records what your application does as spans you can inspect in Braintrust.
